metadata.question: Does the chlorophyll concentration in the Gulf of Mexico off southwestern Florida increase in November 21, 2004 compared to October 30, 2004?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy:
   - Collections: NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI and NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Terra/L3SMI, band 'chlor_a'.
   - Dates: Compare 2004-10-30 and 2004-11-21 over a polygon off SW Florida in the Gulf.
   - Fallbacks: If no daily image: try Terra; then widen to ±1 day (Aqua+Terra); then ±3 days.
2. Masking strategy:
   - L3 SMI chlor_a already masks invalid/cloud pixels. No extra cloud masking applied.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error:
   - Compute unmasked pixel count via Reducer.count; if 0 → C2.
   - If collections empty after fallbacks → C1.
   - If mean is null/NaN or outside [0, 1000] mg m^-3 → C3.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function getInfo(eeObj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    eeObj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

async function computeChlForDate(dateStr, geom) {
  const target = ee.Date(dateStr);

  const aqua = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI').select(['chlor_a']);
  const terra = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Terra/L3SMI').select(['chlor_a']);

  const dailyAqua = aqua.filterDate(target, target.advance(1, 'day'));
  const dailyTerra = terra.filterDate(target, target.advance(1, 'day'));

  const dailyAquaSize = await getInfo(dailyAqua.size());
  const dailyTerraSize = await getInfo(dailyTerra.size());

  // Build fallback attempts
  const attempts = [
    { label: 'Aqua DAY 0d', col: dailyAqua, windowDays: 0 },
    { label: 'Terra DAY 0d', col: dailyTerra, windowDays: 0 },
    {
      label: 'Aqua+Terra ±1d',
      col: aqua.filterDate(target.advance(-1, 'day'), target.advance(2, 'day'))
        .merge(terra.filterDate(target.advance(-1, 'day'), target.advance(2, 'day'))),
      windowDays: 1
    },
    {
      label: 'Aqua+Terra ±3d',
      col: aqua.filterDate(target.advance(-3, 'day'), target.advance(4, 'day'))
        .merge(terra.filterDate(target.advance(-3, 'day'), target.advance(4, 'day'))),
      windowDays: 3
    }
  ];

  let selectedImage = null;
  let usedAttempt = null;

  for (const att of attempts) {
    const sz = await getInfo(att.col.size());
    if (sz > 0) {
      const withDiff = att.col.map(img => img.set('diff', img.date().difference(target, 'day').abs()));
      selectedImage = ee.Image(withDiff.sort('diff').first());
      usedAttempt = att;
      break;
    }
  }

  console.log(`Date ${dateStr}: Aqua day imgs=${dailyAquaSize}, Terra day imgs=${dailyTerraSize}`);

  if (!selectedImage) {
    return {
      status: 'C1'
    };
  }

  // Compute stats
  const band = 'chlor_a';
  const meanDict = selectedImage.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: 4500,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  });
  const countDict = selectedImage.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: 4500,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  });
  const totalDict = ee.Image(1).rename('const').reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: 4500,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  });

  const mean = await getInfo(ee.Number(meanDict.get(band)));
  const validCount = await getInfo(ee.Number(countDict.get(band)));
  const totalCount = await getInfo(ee.Number(totalDict.get('const')));
  const selectedDateStr = await getInfo(ee.Date(selectedImage.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd'));

  if (validCount === 0 || validCount === null) {
    console.log(`Used: ${usedAttempt.label} (selected ${selectedDateStr}); Valid px=0/${totalCount} (0.0%)`);
    return {
      status: 'C2'
    };
  }

  if (mean === null || isNaN(mean) || mean < 0 || mean > 1000) {
    console.log(`Used: ${usedAttempt.label} (selected ${selectedDateStr}); Mean invalid: ${mean}`);
    return {
      status: 'C3'
    };
  }

  const pct = totalCount > 0 ? (100.0 * validCount / totalCount) : 0.0;
  console.log(`Used: ${usedAttempt.label} (selected ${selectedDateStr}); Mean chlor_a=${mean.toFixed(3)} mg m^-3; Valid px=${validCount}/${totalCount} (${pct.toFixed(1)}%)`);

  return {
    status: 'OK',
    mean,
    validCount,
    totalCount,
    selectedDateStr
  };
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions (off southwestern Florida, Gulf of Mexico)
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [
        [-83.8, 26.8],
        [-81.4, 26.8],
        [-81.4, 24.3],
        [-83.8, 24.3],
        [-83.8, 26.8]
      ]
    ]);

    const dateA = '2004-10-30';
    const dateB = '2004-11-21';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const resA = await computeChlForDate(dateA, geom);
    if (resA.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(resA.status);
      return;
    }
    const resB = await computeChlForDate(dateB, geom);
    if (resB.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(resB.status);
      return;
    }

    // 3. Comparison
    const meanA = resA.mean;
    const meanB = resB.mean;
    const diff = meanB - meanA;

    console.log(`Oct 30 mean: ${meanA.toFixed(3)} mg m^-3`);
    console.log(`Nov 21 mean: ${meanB.toFixed(3)} mg m^-3`);
    console.log(`Difference (Nov21 - Oct30): ${diff.toFixed(3)} mg m^-3`);

    // 4. Final Answer
    const tol = 1e-4;
    if (diff > tol) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
